headline: You're closer than you think — clarify the next 90 days
standing_summary: As an early-career professional aiming at flight software roles, you already have relevant coursework and project signals. The main unlock is translating that into operator-ready proof and conversations that stress-test your plan.

key_gaps.title: Mission-relevant proof points
key_gaps.detail: Experts will ask for one artifact that shows how you reason under constraints — not a long résumé list.

key_gaps.title: Network density
key_gaps.detail: With only a small network, prioritize two high-signal intros over broad outreach.

key_gaps.title: Obstacle framing
key_gaps.detail: Name the blocker as a decision you need help making so the live session stays tactical.

expert_conversation_type: A live path review with a flight software or avionics operator who can critique your next three moves.

next_actions.action: Draft a one-page standing note (goal, skills, proof, ask).
next_actions.why: Gives any expert a shared map before the call.

next_actions.action: Pick three questions only an operator can answer.
next_actions.why: Protects live time for advice you cannot get from blogs.

next_actions.action: Book a live expert review with this assessment attached.
next_actions.why: Lets the expert prepare specific advice for your situation.
